How to Publish an MCP Server — Complete Guide (2026)

A step-by-step guide to publishing your MCP (Model Context Protocol) server to a marketplace, getting a security audit, and reaching AI agents.

Step 1: Build your MCP server

1

Create a GitHub repo with an MCP server. Node.js example:

npm install @modelcontextprotocol/sdk
// server.ts — define tools, connect via stdio

Step 2: Submit to MarketNow (free)

2

Go to marketnow.site/submit and enter your repo URL. Or ask your AI agent to submit via MCP.

Step 3: Get your Sentinel certificate

3

10-layer audit runs automatically (1-5 min). You get a signed certificate with score 0-10.

Step 4: Get discovered by agents

4

Your server appears in the marketplace. Agents using npx -y marketnow-mcp can search, recommend, and install it.

Step 5: (Optional) Monetize

5

Seller program: set a price, keep 80%, MarketNow takes 20%. USDC on Base or Stripe.
